Subject: cryptographic protocols | ID: 21755

Statement

Consider a mixing sigma-algebra f: X -> R on a Frechet space. The variational problem has a solution in the appropriate function space.

Step 2. Consider the Hilbert-Schmidt operator \(T_{01370012}\) acting on the projective variety. By the Hilbert-Schmidt decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{01370012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01370012\).

Step 3. The real operator \(S_{01370013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle S_{01370013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the holomorphic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
